script.name: Cold-start named spawn
script.action: In a FRESH session with no prior team history, submit the prompt: "spawn an agent named git-scout to get the most recent git commit"
script.verify: Pull main.log via get_main_process_logs. Confirm it shows TEAM-CONTEXT / MANAGED-TEAMMATE bracketed log lines from TeammateManager.ts. Confirm it does NOT show 'SUBAGENT_TASK started: type=local_agent' (the old failure signature).
script.pass_if: TEAM-CONTEXT/MANAGED-TEAMMATE lines present AND no 'SUBAGENT_TASK started: type=local_agent' line for this spawn.
script.fail_if_reached: If this step fails (still shows local_agent path), STOP -- do not proceed to steps 2-5. Record the failure and flag that 1a's landed fix is broken in a way its own unit tests didn't catch. This would be a genuine PRD-blocking finding.

script.name: UI surfaces
script.action: After step 1's spawn, look at the running app UI.
script.verify: Confirm a teammate chip appears. Open the thread view and confirm it shows a live transcript (PRD 002 surface), not a plain sub-agent inline-expand.
script.pass_if: Chip present, thread view opens and shows live transcript content.

script.name: SendMessage round-trip
script.action: Message the spawned teammate ('git-scout') from the lead session.
script.verify: Observe delivery in logs/UI. Observe whether the teammate's reply reaches the lead.
script.note: If the teammate's reply does not reach the lead due to the upstream asymmetric-SendMessage limitation (anthropics/claude-code#48160, Q2 in the PRD), document the observed behavior but do NOT fail this step on it -- that limitation is outside Nimbalyst's control. Only fail this step if Nimbalyst's own delivery-to-teammate routing does not work.

script.name: Stop + resume
script.action: Use the stop control on the teammate; confirm it works. ASK THE USER FOR EXPLICIT PERMISSION before calling restart_nimbalyst or any equivalent restart action -- do not restart unilaterally. After restart (once permitted), observe whether the teammate resumes/rehydrates.
script.verify: Stop control functions. Post-restart, teammate rehydrates under the SAME synthesized team name it used before restart (this is what task 1b's unit test proved in isolation -- this step proves it live).
script.pass_if: Stop works; post-restart rehydration occurs under the same synthesized team name.

script.name: Control case -- un-named delegation
script.action: Issue an UN-NAMED delegation request (no name in the prompt), e.g. "look up the most recent git commit" with no agent name specified.
script.verify: Confirm it still produces the plain local_agent path and PRD 004's chip/popover surfaces -- i.e. confirm nothing in this PRD broke the existing, correct anonymous-dispatch behavior.
script.pass_if: local_agent path used, PRD 004 chip/popover surfaces render, no teammate card/thread view for this dispatch.
